mapper.select: SELECT r.id, count(d.id) AS details FROM gate_adapter r LEFT JOIN gate_detail d ON d.owner_id=r.id WHERE r.tenant=#{tenant} GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE gate_adapter SET quantity=quantity+1, revision=revision+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND revision=#{version}
UPDATE gate_adapter SET quantity=#{value} WHERE id=#{id}
